interpretation_limits: Finite fit-vs-pilot differences may include distribution shift; overfit or memorization remain hypotheses.
Lambda contrast changes labels, candidate/query selection, portals, oracle selection/weights and queue membership; no isolated label causal claim.
Unchanged/improved abstract target concentration with worseRecall does not establish graph connectivity bottleneck.
Fast frontier counters are unmeasured zero sentinels; exclude from this diagnosis.
hypotheses: Fit target concentration may fail to transfer to pilot target concentration, particularly for targets absent from fit GT10.
A better single-portal fit cache proxy may not change actual multi-entry pilot routes or may fail to improve joint search even when routes change.
scope: Post-hoc descriptive diagnosis of a failed frozen branch; no new confidence intervals, scientific gate reopening, method selection or tuning.

input_boundaries.allowed: Bound completed P3 analyses/models/count/portal verification and saved labels; P0 audited pilot GT top100 first10000 physical records only; existing rawfit GT10 only. No original graph/base/query-vector reads.
input_boundaries.pilot_GT: Verify complete P0 pilot GT-values SHA and per-record header; use ranks0..9, do not read beyond first10000 records.
input_boundaries.fit_GT: Verify fit manifest/P0 fullfit identity and extracted gt10.i32 SHA, count20000, unique10 IDs eachrow.

query_metrics: actual globalGT top4 absolute covered target count/10 M4
target_generalization.oracle_order: All256 leaf GT10 counts descending then leafID ascending; conditional weights normalized only within selected4. Recompute and match saved regions/weights all models/L/queue.
target_generalization.histograms: All exact D1..10 and covered targetcounts0..10 (empty bins retained)
target_generalization.support: f(u)=number of fitGT10 rows containing u; seen iff f>0. Fit targetunseen group cannot exist by definition.
target_generalization.node_population: Allbase, seen/unseen unique-node denominators: final change relativeinit, anypasschange, coarsechange, final lambda0 vs1 difference. Also report pilot targetslot weighted counts separately.
target_generalization.pilot_strata: k_seen(q)=0..10 all eleven exact bins; all10K queries accounted, no bestbin selection
target_generalization.seen_unseen_decomposition: Use the same fullGT selectedtop4 for bothgroups. Covered_s/10 and hit_s/10 contributions must exactly sum to full M4/Recall; optional subgroup ratios have targetslot denominators and empty=null. Do not independently selecttop4 per subgroup.
target_generalization.search_contrasts: All original8fixedP3contrasts plus exactly2 descriptive lambda1-minus-lambda0 oracle_unified contrasts under frequency3 andgreedy3, for bothLs and datasets. Compute savedresultID hits, paired means/gain-loss-equal and oracle NDC/expanded differences per k_seen. No NDC allocation to seen/unseen targets.

portal_exposure.comparisons: All8 original same-lambda greedy3-minus-frequency3 oracle_probability cells (2ds*2lambda*2L); no crosslambda proxytotal comparison.
portal_exposure.proxy_records: Perleaf verification cached greedy/frequency unionhits, eligible target support, chosenportal arrays. These are correlated regional fit proxycounts, not population Recall.
route_classes: same entry set but changed order
portal_exposure.invariance: Same actual ordered route including regions/weights/default/anchor/entries and fixedlabels must reproduce resultIDs/Recall/NDC/expanded/rejected/evicted exactly. Mismatches are integrity failures, not statistics.
portal_exposure.fit_proxy_exposure: Join the fixed four active leaves to their cached delta unionhits and support. Report sumdelta sign negative/zero/positive and normalized perleaf delta/support weighted by saved conditionalweights as a descriptive fit-exposure score only. No threshold selection, newprobability claim or causal interpretation.
portal_exposure.paired_summaries: For all routeclasses and exposure signs report querycounts, changed top10 ID sets/order, Recall wins/losses/equal, mean paired Recall and oracle NDC/counters. Equal Recall must not be equated to same top10.

output: Perdataset summary JSON, complete marker and compact fit20K/pilot10K perquery CSV or NPZ with hashes; no million-row base dump or redundant rawGT dump. Preserve all bins/negative results.

resources.launch: control/stage_run.py P3 analysis; serial root-controlled actual runs
